title: Usage examples
responsibility: Shows committed usage examples and their expected outcomes, with the complete document available to read.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.documentation
inputs.description: Documentation read from this entity at the selected commit; absent or invalid content shows a gap.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.verification
inputs.description: Optional recorded verification content, mounted only when the disclosure opens.

outputs.name: EntityExamples
outputs.description: Named examples with input and expected output or error. Authored examples never imply test verification.
